heading: Sketch your orrery
lead: Shape a first sketch of your piece below. Nothing here is final: it simply gives us a starting point, and we'll refine every detail with you, from proportions to finish.

indoor.label: Indoors
indoor.text: A great room, lobby, gallery or hall.

outdoor.label: Outdoors
outdoor.text: A garden, terrace, courtyard or plaza.

scope.title: The system
scope.intro: How much of the solar system your orrery carries.

tellurion.label: Tellurion
tellurion.text: The Earth, the Moon and the Sun: days, months and seasons, made visible.

inner.label: Inner Planets
inner.text: The Sun with Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars: the rocky worlds.

grand.label: Grand Orrery
grand.text: All eight planets, with Pluto as a bonus.

size.title: Planet size
size.intro: The scale of the worlds themselves.

material.title: Planet material
material.intro: What each world is made of.

pe.label: PE material
pe.text: Light and resilient, finished by hand.

glass.label: Hand-blown glass
glass.text: Each planet blown individually, so no two are alike.

drive.title: The mechanism
drive.intro: What sets the planets in motion.

belts.label: Motors and belts
belts.text: An individual motor and belt for each planet: quiet, smooth and independently controllable.

gears.label: Mechanical gearing
gears.text: A single drive through a train of gears, in the tradition of the first orreries.

sphere.label: Spherical sun
sphere.text: A glowing sphere at the centre.

fireball.label: Fireball
fireball.text: A live, propane-fed flame at the heart of the system. We'll work through safety and siting with you.

messages.auroraNeedsController: Aurora runs on the Planetary Controller, so we've added it.
messages.pavilionOutdoor: The Celestial Pavilion is for outdoor installations.
messages.outdoorSuggestPavilion: Outdoors? A Celestial Pavilion keeps your orrery safe from the elements.

summary.heading: Your sketch
summary.caption: An illustrative sketch, not to scale.

form.heading: Tell us about your space
form.intro: Share a little about where your orrery will live and who will gather around it. We'll reply within one Earth day.
form.noSketch: No sketch yet. That's fine: tell us what you have in mind, or use the builder above.
form.successText: Your enquiry is on its way. We'll be in touch within one Earth day.
